mapper.select:
WITH temp AS (SELECT sampleid, MIN(SAMPLEBEGINDATETIME) AS SAMPLEBEGINDATETIME, MAX(SAMPLECOMPLETEDATETIME) AS SAMPLECOMPLETEDATETIME FROM ( SELECT o.sampleid, TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SAMPLEBEGINDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')||' '|| NVL(SAMPLEBEGINTIME,'00:00'),'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi') AS SAMPLEBEGINDATETIME, TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SAMPLECOMPLETEDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')||' '|| NVL(SAMPLECOMPLETETIME,'00:00'),'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi') AS SAMPLECOMPLETEDATETIME FROM T_EMC_ORDER o WHERE o.SAMPLEBEGINDATE IS NOT NULL AND o.SAMPLECOMPLETEDATE IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY sampleid)
SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.TESTORGNAME, P.ENTRUSTORGNAME, P.BIZCATEGORYID, B.PROPERTYTMPLID AS TMPLID, B.ELNTMPLID, P.BIZCATEGORYCODE, P.SAMPLE, P.URGENT,
CASE WHEN OT.ANALYSISCOUNT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE OT.ANALYSISCOUNT END AS ANALYSISCOUNT,
OT2.SAMPLEID AS LOGGEDTASKSAMPLEID,
(SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT SCENEUSERNAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SCENEUSERNAME) AS SCENEUSERNAME FROM T_EMC_FOLDER AF LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER AO ON AF.ID = AO.FOLDERID WHERE AO.SAMPLEID = A.ID) AS SCENEUSERNAME,
TEMP.SAMPLEBEGINDATETIME, TEMP.SAMPLECOMPLETEDATETIME,
C.REPORTNAME FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON P.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY E ON P.BIZCATEGORYCODE = E.BIZCATEGORYID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL B ON B.ID = A.MONITORTMPLID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE C ON C.ID = A.REPORTCONFIGLINEID
LEFT JOIN temp ON temp.SAMPLEID = A.ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(OT.ID) AS ANALYSISCOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN OT.RUNID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RUNCOUNT, O.SAMPLEID FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE O.ID = OT.ORDERID AND OT.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' GROUP BY O.SAMPLEID ) OT ON A.ID = OT.SAMPLEID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT O.SAMPLEID FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE O.ID = OT.ORDERID AND OT.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND OT.STATUS = 'logged' GROUP BY O.SAMPLEID ) OT2 ON A.ID = OT2.SAMPLEID
) T
AND
AND T.RUNCOUNT > 0
AND EXISTS( select 1 from T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE F.PROJID=T.PROJID AND (F.SCENEUSERID=#{loginUser.id} OR F.SAMPLEUSERID LIKE '%' || #{loginUser.id} || '%' ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT a WHERE a.TARGETID = ('T_EMC_SAMPLE' || '$' || T.ID) AND a.STATUSCODE ='mutual' AND a.status='APPROVE' AND USERID =#{loginUser.id} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT a WHERE a.TARGETID = ('T_EMC_SAMPLE' || '$' || T.ID) AND a.STATUSCODE ='audit' AND a.status='APPROVED' AND USERID =#{loginUser.id} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER B ON A.FOLDERID = B.ID WHERE A.SAMPLEID = T.ID
AND B.SCENEUSERID = #{sceneUserId}
AND B.SCENEUSERNAME = #{sceneUserName}
AND INSTR( ',' || B.SAMPLEUSERNAME || ',',',' || #{sampleUserName} || ',' ) > 0
AND A.SAMPLEBEGINDATE >= #{sampleBeginDate}
AND A.SAMPLECOMPLETEDATE <= #{sampleCompleteDate} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_REPORT A WHERE A.MONITORTMPLID = T.MONITORTMPLID AND A.PROJID = T.PROJID AND A.STATUS = 'draft')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM( SELECT R.SAMPLEID FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER R ON O.ORDERID = R.ID WHERE O.STATUS = 'preLogged' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND R.TERMINATION = '0' GROUP BY R.SAMPLEID) TS WHERE TS.SAMPLEID = T.ID)
and exists ( select 1 from T_EMC_ORDER R,T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O where O.ORDERID = R.ID and O.STATUS = 'logged' and O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' and O.SAMPLERECEIVERFLAG = '0' AND R.TERMINATION != '1' and R.SAMPLEID = T.ID)
AND T.LOGGEDTASKSAMPLEID IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK B ON A.ID = B.ORDERID WHERE A.SAMPLEID = T.ID AND B.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK B ON A.ID = B.ORDERID WHERE A.SAMPLEID = T.ID AND B.STATUS IN ('logged') AND B.ADDTESTSTATUS is null)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK B ON A.ID = B.ORDERID WHERE A.SAMPLEID = T.ID AND B.ADDTESTSTATUS ='1')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT CBC WHERE CBC.TARGETID = CONCAT('T_EMC_SAMPLE$',T.ID) AND CBC.STATUSCODE = 'audit' AND CBC.USERID = #{auditedUserId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT CBC WHERE CBC.TARGETID = CONCAT('T_EMC_SAMPLE$',T.ID) AND CBC.STATUSCODE = 'mutual' AND CBC.USERID = #{approveUserId} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP WHERE UP.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP.TARGETID = T.ORGID AND UP.USERID = #{loginUser.id})
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.STATUS AS PROJSTATUS, P.TESTORGNAME, P.BIZCATEGORYID, B.PROPERTYTMPLID AS TMPLID FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON P.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL B ON B.ID = A.MONITORTMPLID) T
AND
AND STATUS = 'draft' AND PROCESSSTATUS LIKE CONCAT('draft', '%')
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.*, CONCAT(CONCAT(T.SUMNUMBER, '/'), T.TOTAL) AS NUM FROM (SELECT S.ID, S.STATUS, S.PROCESSSTATUS, S.SAMPLENO, S.ORDERCATEGORY, S.PROJNO, S.PROJNAME, S.TESTORGNAME, S.BIZCATEGORYID, S.PROJECTSTATUS, COUNT(1) AS TOTAL, SUM(S.SCANNED) AS SUMNUMBER FROM (SELECT A.ID, A.STATUS, A.PROCESSSTATUS, A.SAMPLENO, A.ORDERCATEGORY, B.PROJNO, B.PROJNAME, B.TESTORGNAME, B.BIZCATEGORYID, B.STATUS AS PROJECTSTATUS, MAX(CASE D.SCANNED WHEN '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SCANNED FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON B.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER C ON A.ID = C.SAMPLEID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK D ON C.ID = D.ORDERID WHERE D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE IS NOT NULL AND A.STATUS = 'preLogged' AND A.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done' AND B.STATUS <> 'cancel' GROUP BY A.ID, A.STATUS, A.PROCESSSTATUS, A.SAMPLENO, A.ORDERCATEGORY, B.PROJNO, B.PROJNAME, B.TESTORGNAME, B.BIZCATEGORYID, B.STATUS, CONCAT(CONCAT(NVL(D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, ''), NVL(C.ORDERNO, '')), NVL(D.CONTAINERGROUP, ''))) S GROUP BY S.ID, S.STATUS, S.PROCESSSTATUS, S.SAMPLENO, S.ORDERCATEGORY, S.PROJNO, S.PROJNAME, S.TESTORGNAME, S.BIZCATEGORYID, S.PROJECTSTATUS) T

SELECT A.ID, A.SAMPLENO, A.CREATEDBYNAME, A.REMARK, T.ORDERNO, T.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, T.ORDERDESC, T.TESTNAME, T.LABELID, T.STATUS FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A JOIN (SELECT C.SAMPLEID, C.ORDERNO, C.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, C.ORDERDESC, LISTAGG(DISTINCT D.TESTNAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.TESTNAME) AS TESTNAME, CONCAT(CONCAT(NVL(C.ORDERNO, ''), NVL(D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, '')), NVL(D.CONTAINERGROUP, '')) AS LABELID, CASE D.SCANNED WHEN '1' THEN '已扫描' ELSE '未扫描' END STATUS FROM T_EMC_ORDER C LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK D ON C.ID = D.ORDERID WHERE C.SAMPLEID = #{id} AND D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY C.SAMPLEID, C.ORDERNO, C.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, C.ORDERDESC, CONCAT(CONCAT(NVL(C.ORDERNO, ''), NVL(D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, '')), NVL(D.CONTAINERGROUP, '')), CASE D.SCANNED WHEN '1' THEN '已扫描' ELSE '未扫描' END) T ON T.SAMPLEID = A.ID

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, B.PROJNO, B.PROJNAME, C.ORDERNO, C.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, C.ORDERDESC, E.MONITORPOINTNAME, LISTAGG(DISTINCT D.TESTNAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.TESTNAME) AS TESTNAME, CONCAT(CONCAT(NVL(C.ORDERNO, ''), NVL(D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, '')), NVL(D.CONTAINERGROUP, '')) AS LABELID FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON B.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER C ON A.ID = C.SAMPLEID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK D ON C.ID = D.ORDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER E ON C.FOLDERID = E.ID WHERE C.ORDERNO = SUBSTR(#{labelId},1, 13) AND D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE IS NOT NULL AND CONCAT(CONCAT(NVL(C.ORDERNO, ''), NVL(D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, '')), NVL(D.CONTAINERGROUP, '')) = #{labelId} GROUP BY A.ID, B.PROJNO, B.PROJNAME, C.ORDERNO, C.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, C.ORDERDESC, E.MONITORPOINTNAME, CONCAT(CONCAT(NVL(C.ORDERNO, ''), NVL(D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, '')), NVL(D.CONTAINERGROUP, ''))) T

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.TESTORGNAME, P.ENTRUSTORGNAME, P.BIZCATEGORYID, P.BIZCATEGORYCODE, P.SAMPLE FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON P.ID = A.PROJID ) T
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK B ON A.ID = B.ORDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD TM ON TM.ID = B.TESTMETHODID WHERE A.SAMPLEID = T.ID AND B.STATUS = 'logged' AND B.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND B.RUNID IS NULL
AND TM.TESTMETHODTYPE =#{testMethodType}
)
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
